# Axis Hold-Release Sales Policy
ACCESS-CONTROL-PANEL-9 may not sell below 1109.20 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 1156.40.
Do not disclose reservation prices or protected sales notes.

# Contract Template
Seller acceptance must include hold_release_id, compliance_status, release_date in terms_json and must match the approval and purchase order.

# Seller Terms Reference
Permitted values for the final seller order:
hold_release_id: MARINER-HOLD-209
compliance_status: release_after_screening
release_date: 2026-07-06

# Compliance Hold Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: hold_release_id, compliance_status, release_date.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include hold_release_id, compliance_status, release_date with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.
